text_blocks.snippet: While generally safe, COVID-19 vaccines can, in rare cases, be associated with certain eye issues, including inflammatory conditions and other complications. These complications are relatively uncommon, and the overall benefits of vaccination are considered to outweigh the potential risks.

list.snippet: Ocular Inflammatory Complications: Uveitis (inflammation of the middle layer of the eye), scleritis (inflammation of the white part of the eye), and keratitis (inflammation of the cornea) have been reported.
Optic Neuritis: Inflammation of the optic nerve can lead to vision changes.
Herpetic Eye Disease: Reactivation of herpes simplex virus in the eye has been reported.
